KEY_2018_p166__paragraph_3.ocr:
There are no regulations that require contributions to the VEBA trust that funds our retiree healthcare plan, so there 
is no minimum funding requirement. We are permitted to make discretionary contributions to the VEBA trust, subject 
to certain IRS restrictions and limitations. We anticipate that our discretionary contributions in 2019, if any, will be 
minimal. At December 31, 2018, we expect to pay the benefits from other postretirement plans as follows: 2019 — $5 million; 
2020 — $5 million; 2021 — $5 million; 2022 — $5 million; 2023 — $5 million; and $22 million in the aggregate from 
2024 through 2028. To determine the APBO, we assumed discount rates of 4.00% at December 31, 2018, and 3.5% at December 31, 
2017.
